name: agents
description: A framework for building realtime voice AI agents 🤖🎙️📹
one_liner: A toolkit for building AI agents that can have real, live voice conversations with people over phone or video.
buyer: A startup founder building a voice-based customer support or sales-call product.
business_use_cases: A startup builds an AI phone receptionist for small businesses (dentists, salons) that books appointments by voice.
A call center replaces first-tier phone support with a voice agent that only escalates complex calls to humans.
An edtech company builds a live AI tutor that talks with students in real time instead of a text chatbot.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a vertical-specific 'AI receptionist' SaaS for a niche like dental offices or salons.
Offer usage-based pricing per call-minute for an AI phone agent product.

steal_this: Build an AI phone receptionist for a local dental office this weekend and charge them a monthly fee to answer calls and book appointments.
